name: cream delite
ingredients_raw: CAKE (80%): SUGAR, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), EGGS, MILK SOLIDS, WATER, HUMECTANTS [INS 422, INS 420(i)], BAKERY SHORTENING, COCOA SOLIDS (4%), LIQUID GLUCOSE, RAISING AGENTS [INS 500(ii)] AND BAKING POWDER, CAKE GEL (INS 470a, INS 471, INS 475, INS 422, INS 420, INS 525), NATURAL COLOUR [INS 150(d)], ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 260), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR VANILLA, PRESERVATIVES (INS 282, INS 200), EDIBLE COMMON SALT, STABILIZERS(INS 412, INS 415), NATURAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (BUTTER). FILLING (20%): BAKERY SHORTENING, MARGARINE, LIQUID GLUCOSE, DEXTROSE, SUGAR, INVERT SYRUP, HUMECTANT(INS 422), CAKE GEL (INS 470a, INS 471, INS 475, INS 422, INS 420, INS 525), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (VANILLA) AND PRESERVATIVES (INS 282, INS 200)
